Blue River PetCare is a nationwide network of high-quality animal hospitals, focused on providing exceptional patient care and collaborative operational support from an experienced team of industry professionals. Committed to providing the industry’s most user-friendly acquisition process, we offer a seamless transition for practice owners who are looking to alleviate the burden of practice ownership and return to practicing medicine or exit the practice to pursue new opportunities.

In addition to providing a long-term home for veterinary practices to continue to grow and thrive, we offer career opportunities for professionals at every stage of their career. Offering both clinical and corporate team positions across the country, we take pride in adding team members who share a commitment to innovative, compassionate veterinary care are committed to finding the perfect fit for each candidate’s individual career goals.
